selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first locate an emerald block placed in the scene (find emerald_block), and then mine podzol that is positioned near or behind the emerald block. The dependency is spatial: the emerald block serves as a landmark/waypoint that the player must navigate to first, and the podzol is placed in a location that is only reachable or discoverable after finding the emerald block. This creates a natural exploration chain where finding the first target leads to the second. Both tasks are observable and verifiable - finding requires proximity/looking at the block, and mining requires breaking the podzol block to collect it. Neither requires deep Minecraft crafting knowledge.

edges.reason: Podzol is hidden behind/near the emerald block structure; player must locate the emerald block first to discover the podzol

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate within 5 blocks of the emerald pillar center at spawn-relative (8, 2, 8) and face toward it. The emerald pillar is 4 blocks tall at x=8, z=8, clearly visible from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually walked to the pillar (not just seen it from afar at spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it, modeling 'the player has found and is observing the emerald block'.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined item ends up in inventory. The Diamond Shovel has Silk Touch enchantment, so mining podzol drops podzol (not dirt). The only podzol in the scene is the 3x4 shed floor at y=-1, z=11-14, so any podzol in inventory must come from mining the shed floor. min_count=1 means at least one podzol block was successfully mined and collected.

scene_description: An open grass field with a prominent 4-block emerald pillar at ~8,0,8 topped with torches serving as a landmark. Behind the pillar is a small oak shed (log walls on 3 sides, fence/gate front, planks roof) with a 3x4 podzol floor at y=-1 from z=11 to z=14. A decorative oak tree at ~-5,0,-5 adds scenery. Player spawns at origin with a Diamond Shovel (Silk Touch + Efficiency III) for mining podzol.
task_text: Find the emerald block pillar in the landscape, then go behind it to discover and mine podzol blocks from the shed floor.
design_notes: Spawn at origin on open grass. Emerald pillar at ~8,0-3,8 is the landmark (Task 1: find). Podzol shed behind it at ~6-10,y,11-14 with podzol floor at y=-1 (Task 2: mine). Silk Touch shovel ensures podzol drops as podzol item. Fence gate at ~8,0,11 provides shed entrance. Decorative tree at ~-5 for natural scenery. All structures within 15 blocks of spawn.
